laws.rule: Taipei City adds named outdoor places where smoking is banned except in marked smoking areas, by notice under the Tobacco Hazards Prevention Act. Examples: the outdoor areas of Taipei Sports Park, Tianmu Baseball Stadium and the Taipei Municipal Tennis Center, and the sidewalks around the NTU Sports Center (from 1 May 2025); outdoor areas at Taipei Dome and some sidewalks and social-housing grounds (from 1 September 2024). The list grows by notice, so check signs and the Department of Health site.
laws.penalty_signal: NT$2,000 to NT$10,000 under Article 40(2) of the Act. Not converted to AUD (no dated rate held).
